boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Oberlin study environments spanning library workstations, quiet carrels, group rooms, and Science Center spaces.

cards.title: Academic Commons
cards.subtitle: Terrell Main Library, Seeley G. Mudd Center
cards.notes: Set up at an individual or group workstation, then use the nearby printers, scanners, multimedia stations, and research support as needed.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped main-floor workspace in Terrell Main Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin describes the Academic Commons as having 29 workstations for individual or group study, plus printers, scanners, an electronic classroom, and multimedia stations.
cards.source_title: Libraries & Collections | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Located on the main floor of Seeley G. Mudd Center; confirm current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Science Library Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Science Library, Science Center
cards.notes: Choose a carrel when you need an individual desk near science collections, then use the library’s scanner or iMac lab if your work calls for it.
cards.short_summary: Individual study seating alongside science-library resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin states that the Science Library has 31 study carrels, an iMac computer lab, a printer, and a scanner.
cards.source_title: Science Library | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Science Library is at 119 Woodland St. in the Science Center; check library hours and policies before arrival.

cards.title: Science Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Science Library, Science Center
cards.notes: Coordinate a small group session in one of the library’s two study rooms, keeping the work close to science reference and research materials.
cards.short_summary: Two small rooms for collaborative work in the Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin’s Science Library page lists two small group study rooms among the library’s facilities.
cards.source_title: Science Library | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: The rooms are in the Science Library at 119 Woodland St.; verify current room-use procedures with the library.

cards.title: Conservatory Library Listening Carrels
cards.subtitle: Conservatory Library, Central Unit
cards.notes: Use a listening carrel to work directly with recordings, then consult scores, books, or periodicals from the music library collection.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated carrels for focused listening and music research.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin reports that students can access recordings in different media formats at any of 43 listening carrels in the Conservatory Library.
cards.source_title: Libraries & Collections | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Conservatory Library is at 77 W. College St.; confirm library hours and equipment availability before visiting.

cards.title: Clarence Ward Art Library
cards.subtitle: Allen Memorial Art Museum
cards.notes: Bring visual-research tasks here and work near books, exhibition catalogs, and journals covering art, architecture, photography, and related fields.
cards.short_summary: An art-focused library on the museum’s top floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin says the Clarence Ward Art Library is on the top floor of the Allen Memorial Art Museum and holds books, exhibition catalogs, bound periodicals, and journals.
cards.source_title: Libraries & Collections | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Located at 83 N. Main St.; consult the library’s current hours before going.

cards.title: Perlik Commons
cards.subtitle: Science Center, 119 Woodland St.
cards.notes: Use the two-story, sun-lit commons for an open-table session; the Science Library and Bent Corridor sit adjacent to the space.
cards.short_summary: An atrium-like Science Center commons with nearby library access.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin describes Perlik Commons as a sun-lit, two-story Science Center commons where students study; it is adjacent to the Science Library and Bent Corridor.
cards.source_title: Perlik Commons, Science Center | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Located in the Science Center at 119 Woodland St.; access may follow building hours.

cards.title: David Love Lounge
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Science Center
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a quieter session overlooking the Commons; keep group work small, as the lounge also supports small social gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor quiet-study lounge overlooking Perlik Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin identifies the David Love Lounge as a second-floor Science Center space overlooking the Commons and describes it as a place for quiet studying.
cards.source_title: David Love Lounge | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Science Center, 119 Woodland St.; access may follow building hours.

cards.title: Science Center Encased Study Ledges
cards.subtitle: Science Center, upper level near Perlik Commons
cards.notes: Take a compact solo task to one of the small encased ledges, which Oberlin identifies for quiet and secluded study within the Science Center.
cards.short_summary: Small, enclosed perches for a brief solo study session.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin states that the Science Center includes small encased ledges for quiet study and that Perlik Commons’ upper level has ledges for secluded study.
cards.source_title: Science Center | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Within the Science Center at 119 Woodland St.; access may follow building hours.

cards.entity_name: Terrell Main Library Upper-Floor Study Rooms
cards.title: Terrell Main Library Upper-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mary Church Terrell Main Library, Seeley G. Mudd Center
cards.notes: Reserve a room for concentrated work or an exam-related session; library accessibility guidance identifies these upper-floor rooms as typically quieter.
cards.short_summary: Quieter reservable rooms on Terrell Main Library’s upper floors.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin Libraries states that study rooms on Terrell Main Library’s upper floors are typically quieter and can be reserved for test-taking needs.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required for the stated use; follow current library room-reservation rules and building hours.

cards.title: Long Term Scholar Studies
cards.subtitle: Mary Church Terrell Main Library
cards.notes: If you are eligible for an assigned study, apply through the library with the required sponsor form and use its wired or wireless campus-network access.
cards.short_summary: Assigned long-term studies for approved students and affiliate scholars.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin Libraries says Long Term Scholar Studies are reserved for assigned students only, require an application process, and provide wired and wireless campus-network access.
cards.source_title: Long Term Scholar Studies | Oberlin College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Restricted to assigned students; eligibility is determined by Main Library staff and assignments are not guaranteed.
